ev.q: Two U.S. cases of encephalomyelitis associated with acute MPXV infection were identified during summer 2022.
Patients A and B had confirmed systemic MPXV infections with encephalomyelitis appearing within 5 and 9 days, respectively, of illness onset.

public_health_question.v: What are the clinical features, workup and treatment of encephalomyelitis associated with acute monkeypox virus infection in the 2022 U.S. outbreak?

ev.q: This report describes two cases of encephalomyelitis in patients with monkeypox disease that occurred during the current U.S. outbreak.
Two Cases of Monkeypox-Associated Encephalomyelitis — Colorado and the District of Columbia, July–August 2022
Two U.S. cases of encephalomyelitis associated with acute MPXV infection were identified during summer 2022.
Details of two cases of encephalomyelitis associated with monkeypox in previously healthy young gay men in Colorado and DC are presented in this report.
it includes only information obtained for purposes of patient clinical care and public health outbreak response.
